explanation: The rebellion’s article says where its fighters and their weapons came from: “The MNLA was formed by former insurgents and a significant number of heavily armed Tuaregs who fought in the Libyan Civil War.” `enabled`, because the Tuareg claim on Azawad is older — the same sentence calls the rising “part of a series of insurgencies by traditionally nomadic Tuaregs which date back at least to 1916” — and what Libya supplied was the men and the arms.
